info.name: Espitalia Patient API
info.description:
Complete API collection for the Espitalia patient mobile app.

**Base URL:** https://espitalia.net/api/

**Auth:** Bearer token — login first, then set `authToken` variable.

**Headers on every request:**
- `Authorization: Bearer {{authToken}}`
- `global-localization: en`
- `content-type: application/json`

**Known Issues (flagged with ⚠️ tests):**
- Dashboard returns empty arrays for all sections
- No categories, doctors, clinics, or services configured on backend

exec: pm.request.headers.add({ key: 'global-localization', value: pm.collectionVariables.get('lang') || 'en' });
pm.test('Status 200', () => pm.response.to.have.status(200));
pm.test('Response OK', () => { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.status).to.be.true; });
pm.test('⚠️ Check payment gateways configured', () => { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.data).to.exist; });

exec: pm.test('Status 200', () => pm.response.to.have.status(200));

pm.test('Status 200', () => pm.response.to.have.status(200));
pm.test('Returns api_token', () => { const j = pm.response.json(); if (j.status && j.data) { pm.collectionVariables.set('authToken', j.data.api_token || ''); } });
pm.test('Status 200', () => pm.response.to.have.status(200));

pm.test('Sets auth token', () => { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.status).to.be.true; if (j.data && j.data.api_token) { pm.collectionVariables.set('authToken', j.data.api_token); pm.collectionVariables.set('userId', String(j.data.id || '')); console.log('Token set:', j.data.api_token.substring(0,20) + '...'); } });

pm.test('⚠️ ISSUE: popular_services should not be empty', () => { const j = pm.response.json(); const s = j.data && j.data.popular_services && j.data.popular_services.selected_service; if (s && s.length === 0) console.warn('BUG REPORT: No popular services configured.'); pm.expect(s.length).to.be.above(0, 'No popular services — section hidden on home screen'); });
